manoeuvres.text: leave the parking lot and at the roundabout take the 1st exit
turn right onto Tbilisi — Red Bridge
at the interchange take the ramp on the left and make a U-turn back onto Tbilisi Street
keep right onto Zakaria Paliashvili Street
make a U-turn onto Megobroba Avenue
at the roundabout take the 2nd exit onto Zhiuli Shartava Avenue
at the roundabout take the 1st exit onto Zhiuli Shartava Avenue
at the roundabout take the 2nd exit
at the interchange take the ramp on the right and make a U-turn back onto Tbilisi — Red Bridge
at the roundabout take the 2nd exit
arrive at the Service Agency parking and stop
